scripts.title: Inf Back Dash
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

while true do
    task.wait(0.05)
    pcall(function()
        Character:SetAttribute("BackwardsDashCD", nil)
    end)
end
